title: Facility for Split DFIA
text: 4.54 Facility for Split DFIA Split Authorisations of DFIA subject to a minimum of CIF value of Rs. 10 lakh each and multiples thereof may also be issued, on request at the time of seeking transferability. Split-up DFIAs shall be permitted with the same port of registration as appearing on the original DFIA.
intent: Support Facility for Split DFIA processing and compliance validation.
